attribution.material: MaleCNS v1 annotations, optic-column assignments and synapse counts

derivation.eye_map_selection: Standard eyemap_mcns_f20240701 only; no DRA substitution.
derivation.column_join: Exact side/hex1/hex2 join to official optic-column name suffix; p/q are not used for this join.
derivation.r1_r6_assignment: Unique maximum and strict majority of all released R1-R6-to-L1 synapses, one official L1 column and agreeing root side; unresolved assignments remain null.
derivation.vector_values: Original embedded six-decimal author x/y/z values and row order are retained; normalization remains in the runtime.
derivation.changes: Retains only column/side/x/y/z and receptor ID/column/availability needed by the runtime; other source columns and metadata are omitted.
derivation.scope: Anatomical correspondence and estimated viewing directions; no physiological validation or additional receptor assignment.
